{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999,999.99
cleaned_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Now parse revenue as float after removing commas
cleaned_sales['revenue'] = cleaned_sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the cleaned revenue values
print("Cleaned revenue range:", cleaned_sales['revenue'].describe())

# Check total rows after cleaning
print("Rows after removing QA orders:", len(cleaned_sales))"}
